name: Hatsu Shigoto Succubus ~Puchi Puni Doji Inma~
original_name: 初仕事サキュバス～プチプニドジ淫魔～
source:
A succubus girl suddenly shows up in your house! She says it's her first attempt to do 
the job to steal human's soul but she's so clumsy that you can do all kinds of things to her...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE239352.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一名魅魔女孩突然出现在你家！她说这是自己第一次尝试偷取人类灵魂的工作，可她笨手笨脚，你可以对她做各种事情……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE239352.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
